props.name: children
props.description: The SelectBox elements contained within the SelectBoxGroup.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The layout direction of the content in each SelectBox.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the SelectBoxGroup is disabled.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: slot
props.description: Slot name when used in a Spectrum context.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLDivElement | ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the underlying listbox element.

props.name: id
props.description: An ID for the listbox.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Handler called when focus moves out of the listbox.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Handler called when focus moves into the listbox.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Handler called when selection changes.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The ID of an element that describes the listbox.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: An accessible label for the listbox when no visible label is provided.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The ID of an element that labels the listbox.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Handler called when the focus state changes.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection mode.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Whether Escape and other collection-level interactions may clear the selection. This is an ARIA behavior override and does not change whether an option press may toggle the final selected item.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Currently selected keys (controlled).

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: Default selected keys (uncontrolled).

props.name: items
props.description: The items to render in the listbox.

props.name: label
props.description: The label for the listbox.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Handler called when an item is activated (pressed).

props.name: shouldFocusWrap
props.description: Whether focus should automatically wrap around.

props.name: disallowTypeAhead
props.description: Whether type-to-select is disabled.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: The selection behavior (toggle vs replace).

props.name: getKey
props.description: Function to get the key from an item.

props.name: getTextValue
props.description: Function to get the text value from an item.

props.name: getDisabled
props.description: Function to check if an item is disabled.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Keys of disabled items.

props.name: disabledBehavior
props.description: Whether disabled items can still receive focus.

props.name: renderEmptyState
props.description: A function to render when the listbox is empty.

props.name: dragAndDropHooks
props.description: Drag and drop hooks from `useDragAndDrop`.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Whether additional items are currently loading.

props.name: isVirtualized
props.description: Whether the listbox uses virtual scrolling.

props.name: shouldSelectOnPressUp
props.description: Whether selection should occur on press up.

props.name: direction
props.description: The text direction, used to resolve the horizontal navigation axis. In a horizontal listbox, RTL flips Left/Right (Right=previous, Left=next).

props.name: hasMore
props.description: Whether there are more items to load.

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Called when the load more sentinel becomes visible.

props.name: shouldFocusOnHover
props.description: Whether to focus items on hover.

props.name: shouldUseVirtualFocus
props.description: Whether options should use virtual focus instead of receiving DOM focus.

props.name: slots
props.description: Slot definitions provided through ListBoxContext.

props.name: linkBehavior
props.description: The behavior of links in the collection.

props.name: UNSTABLE_itemBehavior
props.description: Unstable upstream override that forces items with actions to prefer selection or action behavior.

props.name: shouldSelectOnFocus
props.description: Whether keyboard focus movement should also update selection in single selection mode.

props.name: escapeKeyBehavior
props.description: Whether pressing the Escape key should clear selection in the listbox or not. Most experiences should not modify this option as it eliminates a keyboard user's ability to easily clear selection. Only use if the escape key is being handled externally or should not trigger selection clearing contextually.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique id of the SelectBox.

props.name: children
props.description: The contents of the SelectBox.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: ref
props.type: ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the option element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: An accessible label for the option.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the option is disabled.

props.name: onHoverStart
props.description: Handler called when hover starts.

props.name: onHoverEnd
props.description: Handler called when hover ends.

props.name: onHoverChange
props.description: Handler called when hover state changes.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Handler called when the option is activated.

props.name: item
props.description: The item value.

props.name: textValue
props.description: The text value of the option (for typeahead).

props.name: isVirtualized
props.description: Whether the option is contained in a virtual scrolling listbox.

props.name: shouldSelectOnPressUp
props.description: Whether selection should occur on press up.

props.name: optionId
props.description: Optional DOM id for the option element. Defaults to the key.

props.name: shouldFocusOnHover
props.description: Whether to focus the option on hover.

props.name: shouldUseVirtualFocus
props.description: Whether the option should use virtual focus instead of receiving DOM focus.

props.name: allowsDifferentPressOrigin
props.description: Whether press-up may occur without the press starting on this option.
